keywords: Writ application – Bank employees – Suspension pending disciplinary inquiry – Pawning section – Gold jewellery – Previous disciplinary inquiry concerning 652 pawned items – Reinstatement without back wages – Subsequent investigation concerning different jewellery transactions from 2011–2013 – Allegation of double punishment – Mala fides – Physical verification of gold not conclusive as to caratage – Employer’s entitlement to investigate subsequently discovered misconduct – No merit – Notice refused – Application dismissed. S. Thurairaja PC J. agreed.
legistation: No specific Act or statutory section is identified in the judgment. The dispute principally concerns the disciplinary code of the Pradeshiya Sanwardhana Bank and judicial review of an employer’s disciplinary investigation.
